{{Quote|Republic SIS raided an Imperial Intelligence base on Nar Shaddaa. This information was among dozens of classified data files they recovered.|Leeha Narezz|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
[[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], the intelligence service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], maintained a '''base''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> However, around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;Imperial Intelligence's Republic counterpart&mdash;raided the base, recovering dozens of classified data files. Among the data recovered was a report on a [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|scientist]] who had upgraded the defenses of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]], and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] used that data in her [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|covert assignment]] to locate the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist's]] [[Deference|lost]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] where it had crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] [[3665 BBY|two decades earlier]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Intelligence base was first mentioned in the mission "Suicide Squads" for the Jedi Knight class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" />
